subject: Film & Cinema
title: Georges Méliès: Cinema's First Magician
description: One-minute skill: Georges Méliès: Cinema's First Magician.

hook.text: Before anyone thought films could tell stories, a Parisian magician proved they could.

buildup.text: Méliès built elaborate sets, designed costumes, and invented trick photography.

discovery.text: A Trip to the Moon in 1902 was cinema's first science fiction narrative.

twist.text: He died in poverty — forgotten until film historians rediscovered his genius decades later.

climax.text: Hugo, Martin Scorsese's 2011 film, was a love letter to Méliès' lost legacy.

punchline.text: Cinema's first dreamer was its first forgotten one.

quiz.question: What was Méliès' profession before filmmaking?
